title: Credit Note
dialogDescription: Choose what to credit, confirm the inventory treatment, and review the linked document before creating it.
unchangedNotice: Choose the returned items and quantities. The original invoice remains unchanged.
reasonLegalHint: The selected reason is stored on the legal credit note.
remarksCombinedHint: These remarks are appended to the stored credit-note reason.
itemSelectionHint: Set a quantity above zero to include an item.
noRemainingItems: This invoice has no remaining refundable items.
invalidUnitFraction: Enter a quantity that matches this item's selling unit.
fullyCreditedItem: This line has already been fully credited.
noInventoryImpactHint: This item does not track stock.

packages.invalidFraction: This fraction does not produce an exact stock quantity.
packages.invalidFractionNamed: Enter a valid package fraction for {{name}}.

stockReturnQuestionHint: This answer applies to the selected stock-tracked products.
stockReturnYes: Yes — Add returned goods to stock
stockReturnYesDescription: The product was returned and can be sold again.
stockReturnNo: No — Do not add returned goods to stock
stockReturnNoDescription: Use for damaged, discarded, lost, or products that were not returned.
stockReturnChoiceRequired: Choose whether the product was physically returned.
unitsReturned: {{quantity}} units will be returned to stock
inventoryChoicePending: Choose how eligible goods should affect inventory.
nonStockSelectedCount: {{count}} selected item(s) have no inventory impact.
summaryEmpty: Select at least one item to see the credit summary.
refundAllocationDisclosure: Dafra records the refund allocation. It does not automatically return cash, reverse a card payment, or make a bank transfer.
bankTransferRefundHint: Record a bank transfer completed outside Dafra.
checkItems: Enter at least one valid return quantity
checkInventory: Choose the inventory treatment when required
irreversible: This will create a credit note and cannot be undone.
reportingRejected: ZATCA reporting was rejected. Review the document status.
availableAfterClearance: The final credit note will be available after ZATCA clearance.
clearanceFailedRetryable: Clearance was not completed. Retry from the credit-note details.
clearanceFailedReview: Clearance was rejected or blocked. Review the credit-note status before retrying.
createdReportingPending: Credit note created. ZATCA reporting pending.
createdSubmitted: Credit note created and submitted to ZATCA
createdSubmissionFailed: Credit note created, but ZATCA submission failed. You can retry from the credit note page.
missingResult: The credit note result was unavailable.
linkedSummary_one: {{status}}. One credit note is linked to this invoice.
linkedSummary_zero: {{status}}. No credit notes are linked to this invoice.
linkedSummary_two: {{status}}. {{count}} credit notes are linked to this invoice.
linkedSummary_few: {{status}}. {{count}} credit notes are linked to this invoice.
linkedSummary_many: {{status}}. {{count}} credit notes are linked to this invoice.
linkedSummary_other: {{status}}. {{count}} credit notes are linked to this invoice.
createForSubmitted: Create a credit note or refund for this submitted invoice.
submitFirst: Submit this invoice to ZATCA before creating a credit note.
reportedFirst: Create a credit note only after the original invoice has been reported or cleared.
sequentialDescription: Choose the credit scope, record the refund allocation, then review the issued document.
singleScreenDescription: Choose the credit details, then review the live summary before creating the document.
scopeHint: Start with the remaining refundable value on this invoice.
fullRemainingHint: Credit every line quantity that is still refundable.
selectedItemsHint: Choose the items and quantities to credit.
chooseScopePrompt: Choose what you are crediting to continue.
reasonStepTitle: Why are you issuing this credit note?
remarksFiscalHint: Remarks are appended to the credit reason and may appear on the issued document.
refundStepTitle: How will the refund be recorded?
generationOriginalRefundAllocation: Generation uses the original invoice payment method. Refund allocation cannot be changed for this full-parent note.
generationOriginalRefundUnavailable: The original payment record is not available yet. Wait for it to load before creating this Generation Credit Note.
discardBody: Your selections and notes will be lost.
